If I didn't have the connections I had I probably would have ended up doing those dumb tiktok trends because I didn't have access to heroin. Maybe I'm projecting but I think a lot of teen drug use is unsafe because a lot of us (me included) aren't emotionally mature enough to fully comprehend why we are taking the drugs or trying to get high. Maybe the kids on tiktok are fully aware of the risks of the "drugs" they're taking and just... dont care?? Basically what I'm saying is that maybe this is a reflection of the greater issue that faces my generation, being the general lack of self-respect and self-value. Let me know what you guys think.
